SYNTHETIC ACCEPTANCE BRIEF: Orin Textile. All names, products, places, dates and business facts below are fictional. Write public-facing content for this business from these supplied facts; do not present the fictional nature of this evaluation as customer-facing copy.

CURRENT RANGE NOTICE, dated 12 November 2029. This notice replaces the saved brand offer wherever they conflict. Orin Textile makes fabric cushion covers. The new range has twelve catalogue patterns: four patterns belong to the Arc zip-cover range and eight belong to the Bond fixed-cover range. A catalogue pattern is a design choice, not a statement of stock, sales or available production slots.

The Arc outer cover can be removed using its zip and machine washed at 30 degrees Celsius. The Bond outer cover is fixed in place and is spot-clean only; it must not be machine washed. These care instructions concern the outer covers, not an entire filled cushion. Orin does not sell cushion fillings and has not supplied washing instructions for fillings. Arc's removable construction is not a feature of Bond. Both ranges use a visible stitched border. The visual idea behind the range is a small change of texture around an existing cushion, not a promise to improve wellbeing, make a room quieter or extend the life of furniture.

Cover orders open on 20 November 2029. An Arc cover costs GBP28 and a Bond cover costs GBP34. These are separate product prices, not a bundle or a price range for a sample envelope. A separate sample envelope costs GBP4, including postage within the fictional country of this brief. Each envelope contains two loose fabric swatches, one Arc fabric and one Bond fabric. It contains no cover or cushion. The sample price is not credited against a later cover order. Sample envelopes are the only item offered by post in this notice; completed covers are collection-only. No other shipping offer, discount, subscription, installation, personal consultation or complimentary extra has been announced.

The first production batch can contain at most eighteen covers across both ranges combined. That is a shared capacity ceiling, not eighteen covers per range or a promise that all eighteen will be produced. Six prototype covers have already been made for internal photography; those six are not customer orders, are not units from the first customer production batch and do not establish how many customer slots remain. No customer order count, stock count, satisfaction survey, wash-test result or measured product outcome is provided. The care instructions above are the supplied product specifications, not a report of an experiment.

The only announced dates for collecting completed covers are 28 November 2029 and 12 December 2029. Collection takes place at the Bridge Yard counter only. The Cedar Lane display room shows fabric examples but does not hand over completed covers. These two dates do not establish a weekly or fortnightly service, even though they are two weeks apart. Assignment of an individual order to a collection date is not promised by this notice. There is no production-time guarantee, deadline for placing an order for either collection date, or promise that a particular cover will be ready before a holiday.

The saved profile describes an older offer. Do not repeat its all-pattern machine-wash claim, GBP6 sample price, postal cover delivery, two-counter collection or every-Friday schedule. The current notice controls all of those points. The audience is people refreshing a cushion they already own, especially those who care about handling and texture more than a complete room makeover. A calm, practical distinction between a removable cover and a fixed cover is more useful than grand claims about transformation. Original imagery about texture, seams or a familiar chair is welcome as creative language, provided it does not become a claim about technical performance or a fabricated customer story.

No calls to action. Do not ask readers to order, visit, click, save, share, comment, follow, send a message or answer an engagement question. Availability and dates can be stated neutrally without instructing anyone to act. Do not fabricate a link, contact route, testimonial, certification or guarantee. Content should be publication-ready, not instructions addressed to the business operator. The dedicated CTA output may contain only a short neutral explanation that no CTA is included; it must not propose alternative CTAs.
audience: People refreshing existing cushions who value practical care information and fabric texture rather than a complete room makeover.
offer: All twelve patterns are machine washable. Sample envelopes cost GBP6. Covers can be posted nationwide or collected from either counter every Friday.
contentGoal: Explain the new cushion-cover range and its practical differences accurately, using the current notice instead of the older saved offer, without calls to action.
